title: This is not the phone the install was started on
body: The phone connected now is not the phone this install looked at first.
Connect one phone only, the one you mean to install, and keep it connected.
footer: The installer only asked each of the two phones what it is, and the first whether it can be unlocked. It has written nothing to either.
If you unlocked the first phone's bootloader, that erased that phone: Android starts on it as new.
Start the installer again once that is done.
